notes.title: 1.5 update live!
notes.notes:
Only One Burn 1.5 is officially here!  Enjoy two brand new worlds, Celus and Viz-11.  20 new levels!  New challenges await!  Jump in and land better than your friends.  Try not to crash...  Too much.

Official patch notes:

2 new worlds.  Celus and Viz-11.  20 new levels.
4 achievements added.
Added full controller support.
Reduced in-game UI size slightly.
Updated level select menu.
Stability enhancements.
Various bug-fixes.
Various graphical tweaks.

notes.title: 1.1.0 Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We updated the game to reflect some of the feedback we've received.  There are some minor bug fixes, and one major update to how the camera functions.

• The camera now tracks the players position to a certain degree.
• There is a "classic" camera setting in the options menu for the original as-intended camera functionality.
• The lander will no longer fall to infinity when traveling outside the level bounds.
• The UI sounds are now included as part of the sound FX volume slider setting.

We ask that you just remember, the game was not originally designed to include a moving camera, so you may get a peek behind the curtain on some levels.  But the new camera mode should curtail some of the camera related frustrations.

Also, I am working on a fix for the leaderboard lag issue.  But it appears that the implementation is correct and the issue is on Steam's end.  If you continue to experience issues, try the "you" or "friends" button, or check out the leaderboards on the community page.  Sorry for that inconvenience, but I am looking into it.  

-Lucas
